anomalies.rule: Numbering Integrity — Detect Missing Invoice Number, Duplicates, and Field Conflicts
details: Field: InvoiceId | Current: SAP-BE-2026-01004 | Suggested: Unique business invoice number
InvoiceId must be unique. Multiple rows with the same InvoiceId indicate a duplicate. Ensure only one authoritative document exists or cancel/replace correctly.

anomalies.rule: Mathematical Integrity — Validate Tax Inclusive = Tax Exclusive + Tax with Tolerance and Payable Settlement
details: TaxInclusiveTotal should equal TaxExclusiveTotal + TaxTotal within amount tolerance 0.02. Both TaxExclusiveTotal and TaxTotal must be valid numeric values; null/blank makes mathematical validation incomplete and blocks structured reporting integrity.
